name: China Titans Energy Technology Group Co., Limited
summary: China Titans Energy Technology Group, an investment holding company founded in 1992 and based in Zhuhai, develops, makes and distributes electrical power equipment in China. Its segments are DC power systems, charging equipment, and charging services with construction. Products include DC and low-voltage AC distribution systems, EV fast chargers and charging poles, and energy storage and microgrid converters, and it also leases electric vehicles.
